Admire Groove didn't seem to be feeling well today,
so I urged her to head home.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...It's just a slight headache.
Please, let's continue... the meeting...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
choice_data_list: Please, I need you to rest. I'm begging you...!
Please, I need you to rest. I beg of you...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
How childish...
How selfish of me............
Admire Groove spent a good while afterward clutching her head over both her actions and her headache.
